metadata.title: Research data supporting "A multi-agent system for RNA design with capability-gated prediction and constraint-navigated generation"
metadata.description: Benchmark, anchor-set and campaign evidence for the RNADesignAgent manuscript: the RNADesign-210 benchmark suite plus four further benchmark suites with assertion-curated external anchor sets; frozen per-campaign evidence records (verdict files, dual-arm run records, adjudication materials with sealed blinding maps, audit-trail slices, navigation traces, budget-matching ledgers, reproducibility caches); the packaged capability SelfModel with its generator; the per-experiment model-usage register; and the supplementary information documents. A per-file SHA-256 manifest and a number-to-source-file mapping (PAPER_FACT_SHEET.md) allow every quantitative statement in the manuscript to be re-derived from this deposit.
